shelters.name: Pennsylvania SPCA
shelters.description: For 150 years, rescuing animals from cruelty and neglect. Offers high-quality, low-cost veterinary care options.

shelters.name: Humane Animal Rescue of Pittsburgh
shelters.description: One of Pennsylvania's largest nonprofits. Two domestic animal shelters and Wildlife Rehabilitation Center. Helps more than 25,000 animals annually.

shelters.name: Philadelphia Animal Welfare Society (PAWS)
shelters.description: City's largest no-kill rescue partner and provider of low-cost spay/neuter. Working toward making Philadelphia a no-kill city.

shelters.name: Morris Animal Refuge
shelters.description: Founded 1874, pioneer in Animal Welfare. America's First animal refuge. Committed to adoption, education, and high-quality care.

shelters.name: Animal Friends
shelters.description: Serving Pittsburgh for more than 80 years since 1943. In 2024: rescued 1,429 animals, matched 1,361 pets with adoptive families.

shelters.name: Animal Rescue League of Western PA
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization serving western Pennsylvania and the Pittsburgh area.

shelters.name: Western PA Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Pittsburgh and western Pennsylvania.

shelters.name: Philadelphia Animal Care and Control
shelters.description: City animal care and control providing shelter services for Philadelphia.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Harrisburg Area
shelters.description: Humane society serving Harrisburg and the capital region.

shelters.name: Humane Pennsylvania
shelters.description: Statewide animal welfare organization serving multiple Pennsylvania communities.

shelters.name: Last Chance Ranch
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization serving Bucks County and surrounding areas.

shelters.name: City Kitties
shelters.description: Focuses on rescuing and rehoming cats, providing foster care, medical treatment, and outreach to manage feline overpopulation.

shelters.name: Red Paw Emergency Relief Team
shelters.description: Provides emergency services and support to pets and owners displaced by disasters.

shelters.name: Brandywine Valley SPCA
shelters.description: SPCA serving the Brandywine Valley and Chester County area.

shelters.name: Central PA Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving central Pennsylvania and the Altoona area.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Pennsylvania animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Pennsylvania SPCA has served for 150 years. Morris Animal Refuge (founded 1874) is America's first. Humane Animal Rescue of Pittsburgh helps 25,000+ animals annually. Coverage spans Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, Harrisburg, Reading, and surrounding areas.
